rationale: The previous telemetry indicated that the robot had a high number of line loss events (5 out of 8), suggesting instability. To address this, I have integrated a controller that complements the increased body width and wheel track. The controller parameters are set to enhance stability and responsiveness, with a base speed of 0.1 m/s, kp of 1.5, ki of 0.1, kd of 0.5, and sensor weights adjusted to [1, 1, 1]. This should improve performance in the next race.
